description: Construction of a Four Storied Building for the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences - University of Sri Jayewardenepura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract at a total cost of Rs.601 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
